body:
Good morning!

The neighbors want to send food to families in Bellhaven who need it. The cart goes soon!

Will you read our list and pack it? You're such a good list-reader.
summary: Read the list and pack the cart for Bellhaven.
done: The cart is packed with love!

tasks.where: on the north road out of the village
at the coop by your house
at the pond west of home
